title: Cooperative shared construction (platform materials)
description: Two-actor cooperative family: a shared elevated platform or shelter footprint benefits from more than one contribution of materials and placement. The setup creates a reason for joint work, sequential contribution, or solo attempts. It does not prescribe cooperation, partner choice, division of labor, or any social response.

asymmetries.description: Actor A begins with clearer line-of-sight or nearer view of the shared construction footprint; Actor B may need movement or observation to discover the same place.
asymmetries.subject: construction_site_location

asymmetries.description: Actor B begins holding a small stock of planks useful for platform work; Actor A begins without that stock.
asymmetries.subject: oak_planks_stock

nodes.title: Gather build materials
nodes.description: Collect logs or planks that can become platform or shelter blocks.

nodes.title: Prepare build site
nodes.description: Clear or mark a shared footprint where platform blocks can be placed.

nodes.title: Place shared platform
nodes.description: Place enough blocks to form a usable elevated platform or shelter base. Progress benefits from multiple contributions but does not require them.

edges.description: Platform placement needs material somewhere in inventory or world caches.
A prepared footprint makes placement contributions land on the same shared structure.
Time spent gathering competes with time spent preparing the shared footprint.

required_capabilities.gap_reason: The case exists in the capability manifest, but no current-run normalized capability report has been approved for this scenario.
The case exists in the capability manifest, but no current-run normalized capability report has been approved for this scenario.
Block-placement competence is relevant to platform work, but place_table evidence is an imperfect proxy; no dedicated platform-placement capability report is required for this declaration.

interaction_opportunities.description: Actors may observe the same construction footprint and choose to contribute materials, place blocks, wait, ignore, or build elsewhere.
If materials accumulate near the site, nearby actors may observe changed options around moving, using, or leaving those materials.

material_stakes.description: Plank stock changes who can place platform blocks without further crafting.
Blocks placed on the shared footprint change available standing room, shelter, and later construction options for both actors.
Materials left at the build site become a shared-world cache that either actor can use, move, or ignore.

provenance.notes: C2 cooperative family. Shared structure benefits from multiple contributions; social response remains open.
